no-restricted-syntax.message: Forbidden: bracketed hex utility. Use semantic tokens from src/brand/tokens.ts (text-text-primary, bg-canvas, border-border-strong, etc.). See src/brand/README.md.
Forbidden: off-brand colour token. Only gbd-red, gbd-navy, gbd-white are permitted, and they should be consumed via semantic tokens (text-*, bg-*, border-*).
Forbidden: off-brand tracking. Use tracking-display, tracking-eyebrow, or tracking-button.
Forbidden: arbitrary section padding. Wrap in <Section size="compact"|"standard"|"hero">.
